title: fix: preserve anchor tags with pre-existing target attribute in RenderMarkdown
issueTitle: Bug report: six small defects found tracking master (duplicate operation, RenderMarkdown drops <a>, stale JSDoc, brittle test regexes, bare Error in 3 operations)
why: Of the six defects, only #2 (RenderMarkdown) shows up in the UI, and its suggested repro doesn't trigger it: markdown-it passes a raw HTML <a ...target=...> tag through as inline HTML and never calls the link_open rule, while plain Markdown links never already have a target. Even when the bug fires, the visible text is the same; only whether it is a link changes, so no exact Output text tells the fixed build from the buggy one. The other five defects (a duplicate source file, stale JSDoc, test regexes, a test polyfill branch, and a test assertion) are not visible in the app at all.
